column3: and CPI-common are the published year-over-year percent changes in table 18-10-0256-01. Approximate percentage-point contributions multiply the 2025 basket weight by the calculated 12-month component change and divide by 100. They are not Statistics Canada's published contributions
column4: and they are shown only for the eight major components
column8: and services overlap those components and are not added in. Real wage changes divide the wage ratio by the all-items CPI ratio over the same 12 months. The result is calculated here. The purchasing-power calculator multiplies a dollar amount by the latest monthly all-items index and divides by the chosen year's published annual average all-items index. Both indexes are 2002=100. The personal calculator is a weighted average of the eight published major-component 12-month changes
